name: TWEWY: Calling
source:
Someone is Calling...

It's been four years since the Reapers' Game for Rindo Kanade. In that time, he's finished high school and started attending college, but no choice he makes ever seems good enough. However, without access to Replay anymore, every single one he makes feels just as overwhelming and integral as the last.

[From [url=https://zirkkun.itch.io/calling]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有人打电话…

距离林多奏的收割者游戏已经过去四年了。那时，他完成了高中学业并开始上大学，但他做出的任何选择似乎都不够好。然而，由于无法再重播，他制作的每一首曲子都和上一首曲子一样令人难以抗拒、不可或缺。

[来自[url=https://zirkkun.itch.io/calling]itch.io[/url]]
